item.title: Can You Copyright an AI Logo? (2026 Founder Guide)
item.description: Thinking of using an AI logo generator? In the US, purely AI-generated logos can't be copyrighted. What that means for your brand and trademark, plus 5 questions to ask before you pay for a logo.

item.title: AI Logo vs Human Designer: Who Owns Your Brand?
item.description: A founder's guide to logo ownership, copyright and trademarks in the US and UK, and why a human-designed logo gives your brand stronger protection.
